import os,glob,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}

    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
print(json.dumps(G['Demo pair 1 output']))

def seg_int(v):
    pts=bycolor[v]
    res=set()
    for a,b in itertools.combinations(pts,2):
        r0,c0,r1,c1=a[0],a[1],b[0],b[1]
        dr,dc=r1-r0,c1-c0; steps=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
        if steps==0: continue
        for t in range(1,steps):  # skip endpoints
            y,x=int(r0+t*dr/steps),int(c0+t*dc/steps)
            res.add((y//3,x//3))
    return res

    print(p,sorted(pred),'want',sorted(want),'EXACT' if ok else ('extra' if pred>want else 'short'))

def bands(g,bg):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0])
    cnt=CC(x for r in g for x in r); bgc=max(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    comps=comps_of_grid(g,bgc)
    sizes=[len(c) for _,c in comps]
    mc=max(sizes); mcs=[c for _,c in comps if len(c)==mc][0]
    rs=[r//3 for r,_ in mcs]; cs=[c//3 for _,c in mcs]
    return {'bands':set(rs)|set(cs),'rows':sorted(set(rs)),'cols':sorted(set(cs)),'size':mc}
for p in range(1,8):

    print('   all want',sorted((a,b) for a in range(3) for b in range(3) if O[a][b]==8))

import os,glob,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# per-block features vs output
for p in range(1,8):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    order=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    sec=order[1]
    tbl=[]
    for a in range(3):
        row=[]
        for b in range(3):
            cells=[I[y][x] for y in range(3*a,3*a+3) for x in range(3*b,3*b+3)]
            n_rare=sum(1 for v in cells if v!=bg and v!=sec)
            n_sec=sum(1 for v in cells if v==sec)
            has_bg=bool(sum(1 for v in cells if v==bg))
            # colors present excluding bg
            cols=sorted(set(cells)-{bg})
            row.append(dict(n_rare=n_rare,n_sec=n_sec,has_bg=has_bg,cols=cols,lit=O[a][b]==8))
        tbl.append(row)
    print(p,tbl)
